entries.def:
ἐπι-βαίνω 
[in LXX chiefly for רָכַב ;] 
__1. to get up on, mount: before ἐπί, with accusative, Mat.21.5 (LXX); to embark in (a boat), go aboard: with dative, Act.27.2 before εἰς, Act.21.6 (Rec.); absol., Act.21.2. 
__2. to go up to, go on to, enter: before εἰς, Act.20.18; 21.4; with dative, Act.25.1.†
(AS)

ἐπι-βάλλω 
[in LXX for שָׁלַח, שִׁית, etc. ;] 
__1. trans., to cast, lay or put upon: with accusative and dative, Mrk.11.7, 1Co.7.35; with accusative, before ἐπί with accusative, Rev.18.10, WH, mg.; τ. Χεῖρα (-ας) ἐπί (B1., § 37, 7), of seizing a prisoner, Mat.26.50, Luk.20.19; 21.12, Jhn.7.30, Act.5.18; 21.27; with dative (Polyb.), Mrk.14.46 Act.4.3; with inf., Act.12.1 τὴν χ. ἐπ᾽ ἄροτρον, Luk.9.62 ἐπίβλημα ἐπὶ…

ἐπι-βαρέω, -ῶ 
to put a burden on, be burdensome: figuratively, absol., 2Co.2.6 with accusative of person(s), 1Th.2.9, 2Th.3.8 (cf. M, Th., I, 29).†
(AS)

ἐπι-βιβάζω 
[in LXX chiefly for רָכַב hi. ;] 
to place upon: with accusative of person(s), Luk.10.34; 19.35, Act.23.24.†
(AS)

ἐπι-βλέπω 
[in LXX for נָבַט hi., פָּנָה, רָאָה, etc. ;] 
to look upon. In NT, as in LXX (1Ki.1.11; 9.1, Psa.25.16 Tob.3.3, al.), to look on with favour: before ἐπί with accusative of person(s), Luk.1.48; 9.38, Jas.2.3.†
(AS)

ἐπί-βλημα, -τος, τό 
[in LXX: Isa.3.22 * ;] 
__1. that which is thrown over, a cover. 
__2. a tapestry, hanging (Is, l.with). 
__3. that which is put on; 
__(a) embroidery; 
__(b) a patch: Mat.9.16, Mrk.2.21, Luk.5.36.†
(AS)

ἐπι-βοάω, -ῶ 
to cry out: Act.25.24 (Rec., for βοάω, which see).†
(AS)

ἐπι-βουλή, -ῆς, ἡ 
[in LXX: Est.2.22, I Est.5.73, 2Ma.5.7, al. ;] 
a plan against, a plot: Act.9.24; 20.3, 19; 23.30.†
(AS)

ἐπι-γαμβρεύω
(γαμβρός, a connection by marriage) [in LXX: Gen.34.9, 1Sa.18.21 ff., 2Ch.18.1, Est.9.14 (חָתַן hithp.), Gen.38.8 R (יָבַם pi.), 1Ma.10.54-56 * ;] 
__1. to enter into affinity with: with dative (LXX, H. with, exc. Gen.38.8). 
__2. to marry (as deceased husband's next of kin, cf. Gen.38.8): with accusative, Mat.22.24.†
(AS)

ἐπί-γειος, -ον
(ἐπί, γῆ), 
of the earth, earthly: τὰ ἐ., Jhn.3.12 Php.2.10; 3.19 (anarth.); σώματα, 1Co.15.40 οἰκία, 2Co.5.1 σοφία, Jas.3.15 (Cremer, 153).†
(AS)
